title: Lab: Release Lifecycle
intro_md: Install, upgrade, inspect, and roll back a Helm release — the full lifecycle you'll run in CI and during incidents.

steps.instruction_md: Add the bitnami chart repository (https://charts.bitnami.com/bitnami) under the name `bitnami`.
steps.mock_output: "bitnami" has been added to your repositories

...Successfully got an update from the "bitnami" chart repository
Update Complete. ⎈Happy Helming!⎈
steps.hint: Like apt update, but for charts.

steps.instruction_md: Install `bitnami/nginx` as a release named `web` in namespace `demo`, creating the namespace.
steps.mock_output:
NAME: web
NAMESPACE: demo
STATUS: deployed
REVISION: 1

expected_commands: helm upgrade web bitnami/nginx -n demo --set replicaCount=3
helm upgrade web bitnami/nginx --set replicaCount=3 -n demo
helm upgrade web bitnami/nginx --namespace demo --set replicaCount=3
helm upgrade web bitnami/nginx --set replicaCount=3 --namespace demo
steps.mock_output:
Release "web" has been upgraded. Happy Helming!
REVISION: 2

steps.instruction_md: Show the revision history of the `web` release (namespace demo).
steps.mock_output:
REVISION  STATUS      DESCRIPTION
1         superseded  Install complete
2         deployed    Upgrade complete

steps.instruction_md: The upgrade caused issues — roll back `web` to revision 1 (namespace demo).
steps.mock_output: Rollback was a success! Happy Helming!
